entities.name: Succinylglutamate desuccinylase
observations: The 324-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Acinetobacter baumannii succinylglutamate desuccinylases B7GVV1, B7IA88, and B0V7X4; identity and coverage are 100%.
Catalyzes hydrolytic cleavage of N(2)-succinyl-L-glutamate to L-glutamate and succinate; EC 3.5.1.96, Rhea RHEA:15169.
Binds one Zn(2+) ion per subunit; curated GO terms include succinylglutamate desuccinylase activity and zinc ion binding.
Pfam evidence identifies AstE_AspA_cat (PF24827.2; residues 44–231) and AstE_AspA_hybrid (PF04952.21; residues 249–322).

entities.name: N-succinyl-L-glutamate hydrolysis
observations: Chemical reaction: N-succinyl-L-glutamate + H2O = L-glutamate + succinate.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:15169 and catalyzed by succinylglutamate desuccinylase EC 3.5.1.96.

entities.name: Zinc cofactor
observations: Succinylglutamate desuccinylase binds one Zn(2+) ion per subunit; zinc is associated with its hydrolase catalytic activity.

entities.name: Arginine degradation AST pathway
observations: The enzyme performs step 5 of the L-arginine degradation via the AST pathway, producing L-glutamate and succinate from N-succinyl-L-glutamate.
